high_level_description: The image depicts a solemn ceremony or memorial event. The setting appears to be indoors, with a large hall adorned with blue and purple curtains in the background. Rows of coffins are lined up, each covered with a cloth that features the colors of the Indian flag—orange, white, and green—and a circular emblem resembling the Ashoka Chakra, which is part of the Indian national flag. In front of the coffins, there are uniformed personnel standing at attention, suggesting a military or paramilitary presence.
